pages.title: 海德林诱惑术
pages.text: $(bold)目的$()：$(#AA00AA)魔精$()附身$(br2)$(bold)海德林诱惑术$()能吸引$(#AA00AA)魔精$()，并强迫其附身于附近生物。该五芒星阵能进行基础的附身仪式，只会召回低阶魔灵和被附身的生物。$(br)

pages.title: 用途
pages.text: $(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_endermite)被附身的末影螨$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_skeleton)被附身的骷髅$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_witch)被附身的女巫$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_phantom)被附身的幻翼$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_unbound_parrot)未受缚的鹦鹉$(/l)$(br)$(li)$(l:possession_rituals/possess_random_animal)随机动物（普通、水生、小型）$(/l)$(br)$()
